# Local zbus 6 migration

Published `accesskit_unix 0.22.1` source, with original license files.
Adapt dependency manifests and native D-Bus consumer APIs to maintained zbus 6.
Preserve existing accessibility data model, portal and keyring behavior.
See `docs/dependency-maintenance.md` for verification and runtime costs.

The published crate omits the workspace license files. `LICENSE-MIT` and
`LICENSE-APACHE` are unchanged upstream bytes from the crate's recorded revision
[`c88605b96d04431f9c3c792464a0f2f253480e94`](https://github.com/AccessKit/accesskit/tree/c88605b96d04431f9c3c792464a0f2f253480e94).
